declaration.preface:
At THE AML RIGHTSOURCE GROUP of companies, we are committed to upholding fair labor practices and safeguarding human rights across all aspects of our operations. As a leader in financial crime compliance, we recognize the importance of fostering a workplace built on respect, dignity, and equality. Our Fair Labor and Human Rights Policy reflects our unwavering dedication to ethical business conduct, ensuring compliance with international labor standards and human rights frameworks, including the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the International Labour Organization (ILO) conventions.

This policy aims to promote fair treatment, prevent discrimination, and protect the rights of all individuals within our workforce, including employees, contractors, and suppliers. By embedding these principles into our daily practices, we strive to create a safe, inclusive, and empowering environment where everyone can thrive professionally and personally.
declaration.declaration: The purpose of this Fair Labor and Human Rights Policy is to affirm AMLRS commitment to ethical labor practices and the protection of human rights across all operations. This policy ensures compliance with international labor standards, promotes fairness, and safeguards the dignity of every individual associated with AMLRS, including employees, contractors, and partners. It aims to prevent discrimination, eliminate exploitation, and foster an inclusive environment built on respect and equality. By embedding these principles into our operations, AMLRS reinforces its dedication to social responsibility, integrity, and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
declaration.scope:
This Fair Labor and Human Rights Policy applies to all operations, legal entities, offices, partner offices, registered business addresses, remote work locations, and other workplaces of the AML RightSource Group of Companies ("AMLRS"), including all subsidiaries, affiliates, and controlled entities operating in the United States, Canada, Germany, Poland, Austria, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, Denmark, Bulgaria, India, Singapore, Hong Kong, Brazil, and Malaysia, as well as any future locations where AMLRS conducts business.

The policy applies irrespective of whether business activities are carried out from AMLRS-owned or leased premises, partner offices, co-working spaces, client locations, registered legal addresses, or remote work environments. It covers all employees, including full-time, part-time, temporary, fixed-term, and contract employees, interns, consultants, agency workers, and management. The policy also extends to suppliers, vendors, contractors, service providers, business partners, and any other third parties engaged in providing products or services on behalf of AMLRS.

All individuals and entities covered by this policy are expected to comply with its requirements and uphold AMLRS's commitment to respecting internationally recognized labor and human rights standards throughout its global operations.

policy.monitoring:
Regular and transparent reporting practices are essential for monitoring progress, identifying potential risks, and ensuring accountability in our commitment to labor and human rights. We adhere to the following reporting procedures:

Annual Labor and Human Rights Performance Reviews: We conduct yearly evaluations to assess our adherence to labor and human rights standards, collecting data on key metrics outlined in our framework.

Internal Assessments: Internal assessments are carried out regularly to ensure compliance with labor laws, evaluate the effectiveness of our management systems, and identify areas for improvement.

Stakeholder Communication: We actively engage with stakeholders, including employees, partners, regulatory bodies, and communities, to address concerns, gather insights, and transparently report on our progress and initiatives related to labor and human rights.

We are committed to continuously improving our labor and human rights performance. Our goal is to foster a fair, respectful, and ethical workplace for all. We regularly update our Labor and Human Rights guidelines, incorporating best practices, employee feedback, and legal developments. Our ongoing efforts include:

Enhancing workplace safety, health, and well-being.

Promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Strengthening employee rights and ensuring fair working conditions.

Implementing new programs and technology to support employees' rights and welfare.

By continuously refining our approach, we aim to exceed regulatory requirements and create a workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect.
